name: An Old History Book
summary: Milton Sheaf awaits a lost Stormwind chronicle at the Royal Library. The book, The History of Stormwind, bears the library’s seal and vanished before the kingdom rose again after the First War. Its return may help preserve the history of the southern human lands.

sections.title: A Relic of the First War
sections.body: You find the mud-caked book among the ruins of Duskwood, where undead and ogres roam. Its first page bears Stormwind’s formal library seal, marking it as a rare relic from before the city’s destruction. It was checked out decades ago, before the Horde razed the capital, and was thought lost when the south fell.

sections.title: Restoring Forgotten Annals
sections.body: Milton Sheaf recognizes the book when you bring it to the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep. He plans to place it in the rare books archive, though years in the haunted wilds have badly damaged its pages. The discovery sends Sheaf seeking more lost knowledge in Southshore, the nearest town to Alterac’s ruined kingdom and abandoned libraries.

aliases: where to find old history book
faq.answer: You find the book among the hostile creatures of Duskwood, often among undead in cemeteries and fields or ogres in the southern hills.

faq.q: Who do I bring the book to?
aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Bring the volume to Milton Sheaf, head librarian in the Royal Library inside Stormwind Keep.

faq.q: Why is the book in such poor condition?
faq.answer: The book was checked out before the First War and Stormwind’s sack. It spent decades in Duskwood’s wilderness, exposed to dirt and rot and handled by wandering scavengers and monsters.

faq.q: Does returning this book lead to other tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. Milton Sheaf sends you north to Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills to speak with Loremaster Dibbs, who can direct you to books in the Ruins of Alterac.

faq.q: Why does Milton Sheaf care so much about this specific tome?
faq.answer: Few original records survived the kingdom’s fall and Stormwind’s burning during the First War. Genuine pre-war texts help scholars piece together the kingdom’s past.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this quest?
faq.answer: No. The book belongs to Stormwind’s Royal Library, and only Alliance librarians in Stormwind Keep can accept it.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help restore fragments of Stormwind’s heritage that survived the First War’s ruin.
As a human of the south, you help reclaim written records from the wilds and rebuild a culture shattered by the Old Horde.
As a mage, you know ancient libraries hold knowledge that can decay or be neglected when left in the wild.
